payload.name: Dorsomedial Striatum (DMS) Habit Bias
payload.fact: Dopamine release in the dorsomedial striatum (DMS) increases during action-sequence initiation and decreases during action-sequence completion in habitual rats, and optogenetic stimulation of DMS dopamine release accelerates habit formation.

provenance.title: Striatal dopamine signals are region specific and temporally stable across action-sequence habit formation
provenance.quote_or_locus: DMS dopamine release increased during action-sequence initiation and decreased during action-sequence completion in habitual rats, whereas non-habitual rats showed opposite effects. Consistently, optogenetic stimulation of DMS dopamine release accelerated habit formation
